newsitem.title: USA: Andrew Corp Q1 orders rise.
newsitem.headline: Andrew Corp Q1 orders rise.

text.p: Andrew Corp said Thursday orders for the first quarter ended December 31 totaled $228.4 million, up 27 percent from $179.8 million last year.
Backlog to be shipped over the next twelve months rose 12 percent to $142.4 million. Total backlog rose three percent compared to $154.6 million.
Earlier, Andrew reported earnings for the quarter of $0.40 a share, up from $0.28 a year ago, and sales of $231.7 million, up from $177.9 million.

"Both domestic and international markets drove orders and sales strength," Floyd English, chairman, said in a statement. "In the United States, the most notable contributors to sales growth were infrastructure construction of personal communications services and wireless hand set accessories. The South American market led the international growth."

He added that recent acquisitions contributed to growth in the quarter, including The Antenna Co, acquired in March 1996, and the Brazilian companies, in which a majority interest was acquired in December 1995.
Andrew supplies communications systems and services.
